headword: {五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}

definitions.explanation: A rich harvest of all the crops. A four-character phrase used mainly in prayers at shrines and in the names and purposes of festivals.

examples.japanese: {五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: To pray for a bountiful harvest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋祭|あきまつ}り→秋祭り：31232_akimatsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
examples.english: The autumn festival celebrates a rich harvest.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Every spring this shrine holds a festival to pray for a good harvest.

notes:
{五穀|ごこく} (the five grains: traditionally rice, wheat, two kinds of millet and beans) + ⟦{豊穣|ほうじょう}→豊穣：18547_houjou⟧ (abundant harvest).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to pray for a good harvest
- {五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧: to celebrate a good harvest
- {五穀豊穣|ごこくほうじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無病息災|むびょうそくさい}→無病息災：31774_mubyousokusai⟧: good harvests and good health, a common pair in festival prayers

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Shinto festivals, from spring planting rites to autumn harvest festivals, are held to pray or give thanks for a good harvest.
